# Ruthvik Anne (also written Anne Ruthvik)

> Ruthvik Anne is a software developer based in Vijayawada, India, and a B.Tech CSE student (2025-2029) at Siddhartha Academy of Higher Education. He builds AI platforms and agent systems, model-training pipelines, full-stack web apps, Android apps and security-first backends.

## Main page
- [Portfolio](https://ruthvik-anne.github.io/Personal_Site/): projects, organisations, 2026 build log, research notes, stack and contact.

- [GitHub: Halcyon Technologies](https://github.com/Halcyon-Technologies): organisation he works in (Awan, Dawn, Armo, devtools).
- [Hugging Face: ruthvikanne](https://huggingface.co/ruthvikanne): public datasets.

## Facts
- Open to: internships, research collaborations and product work (web and Android apps, AI and LLM integration, backend services).
- Stack: Python, Rust, Go, C, C#/.NET, Kotlin, TypeScript, React, Next.js, FastAPI, PostgreSQL.
- Many projects are private or at design stage; the site labels each status literally ("Specs", "Blueprint", "Prototype", "Built").
